transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I've been feeling incredibly down and depressed for about the last three months. I've completely lost interest in all of my usual hobbies and activities, and nothing seems to bring me joy anymore. I just can't bring myself to care about the things I used to love.
Have you ever had periods in your life where you felt the exact opposite—unusually energetic, on top of the world, or hyperactive, perhaps needing very little sleep?

No, I've never experienced periods of feeling unusually energetic or on top of the world. My energy levels have always been normal or quite low, especially recently. I've never felt hyperactive like that.
During this difficult time, have you experienced anything unusual, like hearing voices or seeing things that others can't, or feeling like people are watching or plotting against you?

Yes, actually... it's been really terrifying, and I've been scared to admit it. Lately, I've started hearing whispering voices and seeing things that aren't there, and I feel this constant, awful dread that people are watching or plotting against me. These strange experiences only started happening recently, during these past three months since I've been feeling so deeply depressed.
Have you ever experienced these whispering voices, visions, or feelings of being watched during times when your mood was completely normal and you weren't feeling depressed?
No, never. Those terrifying experiences only happen when I'm feeling deeply depressed, and I've never had them when my mood was normal.
